promptTemplate: Use case: precise-object-edit. EDIT THE SUPPLIED ORIGINAL GAME SPRITE SHEET, not a new character drawing. This sheet contains genuine original 2009 Plants vs Zombies skeletal parts, enlarged with nearest-neighbor pixels. Preserve the original coarse low-resolution soft painted art, thin irregular dark brown outlines, muted colors, flat broad shading, and all attachment silhouettes. No realistic textures, glossy highlights, modern vector finish, thick outlines or 3D cylinders. TRUE TRANSPARENT BACKGROUND. Exactly 3 columns x 3 rows in the same order and positions. Row 1: unchanged upper HEAD reference (no jaw); TORSO only (no head, arms or legs); INNER UPPER ARM. Row 2: unchanged detached LOWER JAW reference; OUTER UPPER ARM; INNER FOREARM. Row 3: detached HAIR or named HAT only, never a head; OUTER FOREARM; DAMAGED OUTER UPPER ARM with original small dry cartoon bone stump, no gore. Keep every arm in its EXACT ORIGINAL ORIENTATION and original length, slope, ragged contour, elbow/wrist attachment pads. Sleeves cover the same regions as original; DO NOT turn the original clothed forearms into long bare green cylinders, DO NOT add hands. Keep clothing on the torso separate from sleeves. Never add shoulder sleeves to the torso. Preserve original head, eyes, teeth, jaw and gray-green skin without redesigning them. No full assembled character, text, grid, shadows or extra pieces. Treat this as painting changes over the existing pixels, not reinterpreting the anatomy. Variant clothing and accessory specification follows:

variants.identity: Parcel delivery costume: original ragged brown jacket with an ochre diagonal parcel strap, one large rectangular folded-paper pocket on its back edge and small beige tape patches. Brown sleeves with one beige elbow patch. Preserve original ragged jacket silhouette, adding only a small paper-pocket bulge. Keep original hair. The cardboard helmet is a separate existing part; DO NOT paint a helmet on the head or torso.

Old marching cheerleader coat: muted worn oxblood-red short jacket with a broad faded brass diagonal sash and two simple brass buttons. Matching red sleeves with simple ochre cuffs; keep their shapes exactly original. Original hair. Hand-held bell is a separate existing bone, do not draw any bell or staff here.

Bubblegum vendor: faded dusty rose ragged jacket, small cream candy-striped front pocket, two round wrapped sweets peeking from the pocket. Matching dusty rose sleeves. Use the original adult zombie head unchanged, no youthful face. Preserve original hair. No bubble attached to the face; bubble is an existing separate effect.

Ice delivery worker: faded slate-blue work jacket with broad off-white inner lining and one very small angular ice chip caught in the side pocket. Simple slate-blue sleeves, off-white cuff trim. No snow texture, no glow, no large icicles. Original head and hair unchanged. Helmet is a separate existing sprite; do not add a bucket here.

Electric repair worker: faded blue-gray short work coat, two broad ochre electrical straps, a small chunky rectangular old battery pack protrudes just beyond the rear waist silhouette with two simple dark cable curves on the coat. Matching sleeves with ochre cuffs. The larger chest battery is an existing separate bone; do not duplicate it. No neon, sparks or glow. Original head and hair unchanged.

Lightweight courier: faded khaki waistcoat over thin light olive sleeves, one folded map in a chest pocket. Do not shorten the arms or body: game applies whole-character small scale. Bottom left HAIR piece becomes a detached low soft olive cloth cap only; native left-facing three-quarter perspective, small slouching silhouette, no face below it. Original head and jaw unchanged.

Slow armored road worker: original brown work coat under two dull gray broad strapped chest plates, one cracked lower corner; no bulky shoulder armor or arms on torso. Brown sleeves with small dark rectangular elbow reinforcement patches. Keep native thin arm shapes. Original hair and face unchanged. Reinforced cone helmet is separate, do not add a helmet here.

Mechanic: faded olive work coat with a large tan canvas tool apron sitting ON the original torso shape, one small wrench and screwdriver sticking from its two broad pockets. Muted olive sleeves with tan cuffs. Keep native sleeve anatomy. Original head and hair unchanged. Bucket helmet separate, do not add one here.

Smoky chimney worker: muted charcoal-brown coat, cream scarf edge across chest, a small closed black canister attached behind the waist with one curved strap. Dark brown matching sleeves, broad shading only. No drawn smoke cloud; smoke is an animated effect. Bottom left separate small charcoal cloth cap, low rounded floppy silhouette, original left-facing three-quarter angle. Head and jaw unchanged.

Carrier zombie: faded plum-brown long ragged coat, one tan diagonal carrier strap across chest and two small plain folded parcel pouches on the back edge. Keep original thin adult anatomy, no extra faces or attached mini-zombies. Matching plum-brown sleeves. Bottom left a detached small muted purple patched cloth cap only. Head and jaw unchanged.

Paper-ball thrower: faded navy ragged jacket over an off-white shirt with a diagonal brown satchel across the torso, two simple crumpled cream paper shapes visible in the satchel at waist. Navy sleeves, retain original long cloth forearms and cuffs exactly rather than rolled-up sleeves. Bottom-left HAIR slot becomes ONLY a detached small folded off-white newspaper boat hat, no glasses, no head or face; original left-facing three-quarter view. Head and jaw unchanged. No paper ball on any hand or limb; thrown ball is a separate effect.

Painter: muted plum short coat under a faded tan simple apron with exactly three broad dark purple paint stains and a small round paint pot in the lower apron pocket. Plum long sleeves with original narrow shapes, no inflated shoulder or bare cylindrical forearm. Bottom left a detached small dark plum artist beret only, drooping to the right, no mustache or face. Head and jaw unchanged. No brush or projectile on limbs; projectile is a separate effect.
